pages.text: Relays, punch cards and pneumatic tubes.$(br2)In this era, all items are still stored in generic chests or other inventories, however, these can be connected via Tube Stations and a network of Pneumatic Tubes linked via a Tabulator Machine and a Teletype Typewriter to create a central storage hub and network.

The Tabulator Machine's holds Card Decks comprised of set Punch Cards, these cards are used to mark the location of a Tube Station to the network.$(br2)Memory: $(ec_memory:era1)$(br)Part: $(ec_part:era1)
